_comment: Downloadable inputs for the S4 detector benchmark (docs/plan/04-spikes.md). Nothing listed here is committed to the repository or shipped in the app. Every entry records its licence as stated by its source; unverified points are in 'licence_note'.

sources.licence_note: From the model card README. The model was trained on GigaSpeech XL; the terms of that training data were not verified, so check them before bundling this model in the app (docs/plan/02-platform-facts.md, P27).

sources.role: text-to-speech voices used only to synthesize test audio
sources.licence_note: LICENSE file in the archive is Apache-2.0. Used to make test audio only; never shipped.

sources.role: public-domain text for the sentences spoken by the synthetic talkers
sources.licence_note: Project Gutenberg texts as packaged by the NLTK data project. Public-domain books; checksum is pinned on first fetch (fetch.py --pin).

sources.role: voice-activity model for the duty-cycle measurement (candidate stage 1)
sources.licence_note: LICENSE of the silero-vad repository at tag v6.2.3 (checked 2026-10-21). The pip package of the same name is not used because it requires PyTorch.
